name: portfolio-ai
description: Python FastAPI AI / RAG service (uses local myenv)

scripts.install:env: sh -c 'if [ ! -x myenv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv myenv; fi && myenv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && myenv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt'
scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x myenv/bin/python ]; then myenv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000; else echo "Missing myenv. From repo root run: npm run install:backend"; exit 1; fi'
